The Great-grand Gnawhorde > Summon Vermi.declare: If there is not a friendly Vermintide on the battlefield, pick a friendly GNAWHORDE WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Reverberating Ritual.declare: Pick a friendly GNAWHORDE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly GNAWHORDE INFANTRY unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Icon of Great-total Supremacy.effect: You can return up to D3 slain models to each friendly GNAWHORDE INFANTRY unit with a Health characteristic of up to 3.

Untapped Mutation.declare: Pick a friendly MUTATED MENAGERIE WIZARD to cast this spell, pick up to 3 visible friendly MUTATED MENAGERIE units wholly within 13" of them that are affected by the 'More-more Mutation!' ability to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
